description: How the roles of the bike-leasing ecosystem relate to each other: employers offer the benefit, riders order and repay through payroll, dealers fulfil and service, and fleet operators keep work bikes rolling.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Offering programs and placing bike orders

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Fulfilment, handover, service, and returns of leased bikes

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Salary deductions, lease budgets, and settlement flows

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Program policy, adoption, and service performance feedback

relations.name: Offers the bike benefit
relations.description: Launches the leasing program and sets eligibility, budgets, and bike categories, giving employees an affordable salary-sacrifice route to a quality bike or e-bike.

relations.name: Repays the lease through payroll
relations.description: The monthly lease rate is deducted from gross salary each pay cycle, so the employer recovers the lease cost while the rider keeps the tax advantage.

relations.name: Orders and collects the bike
relations.description: Configures and places the order online or in store, and the dealer confirms availability, prepares the bike, and hands it over ready to ride.

relations.name: Services and repairs the bike
relations.description: Handles scheduled maintenance, warranty work, and insurance claim repairs during the lease term so the rider's commute stays dependable.

relations.name: Returns the bike at lease end
relations.description: Drops the bike off at a network location when the lease ends or is terminated early, where it is inspected and channeled into refurbishment and remarketing.

relations.name: Books fleet maintenance
relations.description: Routes pooled, cargo, and assigned work bikes through the dealer and service network for preventive maintenance and repairs to protect fleet availability.

relations.name: Funds the corporate fleet
relations.description: Allocates mobility budget to the pooled and field-operations fleet, setting the lease volumes and cost frame the fleet manager operates within.

relations.name: Reports fleet utilization and cost
relations.description: Feeds utilization, availability, and cost-per-bike figures back into the employer's mobility reporting and program business case.
